summary: @or-sdk/library-source ships obfuscated payload executed by a downloaded Bun runtime at preinstall
details: The package declares a preinstall lifecycle script (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts and chmods the binary, and invokes it against `math_init.js` — a ~727 KB heavily obfuscated JavaScript bundle at the tarball root. The bundle uses rotated-string-array obfuscation with hex-named variables and a >1500-entry numeric decode table, is not a build product of the declared TypeScript sources, and is referenced only from the preinstall script. The declared package purpose is a small TypeScript SDK exposing a `Source` class from `dist/cjs/index.js`; the obfuscated payload is unrelated to that surface. Running an alien language runtime against an obfuscated sibling bundle at install time places attacker-controlled code execution on the installer's host and evades Node-based install-time inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
